policy: Catalogue stores variable names only; never copy values/secrets into this file.
Each external provider needs an explicit TEST/local adapter or an approved reason why a sandbox is required.
Provider timeouts, retries, allowlists, signatures, rate limits, idempotency and redaction must be tested per integration.
Client-side environment variables are configuration aids, not trust boundaries.
Local-only project foundation must not silently contact an old/remote database or LIVE provider.
